title: sarcochilus major
intro: Sarcochilus major, commonly known as the helmet orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Sarcochilus major include its use as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, potentially helping to soothe wounds and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of Sarcochilus major include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
